checks: Review the complete lodged deed PD-6834-R and omitted schedule, and confirm any later changes affecting office or object status. Clause 4 requires joint discretion over income and capital; object status creates no entitlement before an appointment in the object's favour.

Under clause 6, verify joint delivery of any proposed addition as a deed and the person's eligibility under the clause. No settlor consent is required. Obtain a legible register record or inspect the original to match SD-Q7M2 to the parent deed, establish the delivery date and identify who jointly delivered it. Do not treat the March transcript check as delivery.
Reconcile Alder Quay's own decision and payment records. For each actual authorisation, cite the recorded decision and confirm the payee, amount and payment status.

Review the complete lodged deed PD-6894-R and omitted schedules, and confirm any later changes affecting office or object status. Under clause 5, the trustees act together and may apply funds directly for an object's benefit; eligibility alone gives no right to payment.

Under clause 8, verify joint delivery by all serving trustees of any proposed addition as a deed, with the correct parent reference, and verify the person's eligibility under the clause. No other person's consent is required. Look for Flint Orchard's own delivery evidence; do not reuse the Alder Quay custody entry.
Reconcile Flint Orchard's own decision and payment records. Do not carry over a decision, expense, or eligibility finding from Alder Quay.

companion_register.record: In j8f2 Maren Dovell, Meeting Secretary, reports one 17 June slot booked with Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell and reports both in office for both settlements from the appointments book. The booking establishes neither actual attendance nor a joint decision. Confirm serving trustees and attendance for each decision; minute the decisions separately and circulate late papers separately from the closed preparation set.

h6q3 reproduces the signed and witnessed text of SD-Q7M2, naming Rhea Marden as a living individual and Della Pennick as the in-person witness to both signatures. Alys Morcant checked the transcript against the signed paper on 26 March 2026, but did not certify delivery. r5n8 records immediate delivery, not escrow, for one original under a specified parent reference; Gideon Sarn's entry memorialises that handover and does not make a designation. The unresolved issue is whether those records concern the same paper.

companion_register.matter: Claim that SD-Q7M2 itself removes an object, appoints property or directs payment
companion_register.record: The signed instrument reproduced in h6q3 expressly does none of these. Even if effective delivery is later established, the instrument is an addition only.

companion_register.matter: Ione Berrick's travel estimate and Sella Quist's limited permission
companion_register.record: Ione reports in b9k4 that the replacement estimate had not arrived as of her 18 February letter and the old one was unreliable. She permits Sella to pass on the replacement when it arrives and offers to sign confirmations herself. This is permission to transmit paperwork, not authority to sign, act generally for Ione, or receive a distribution on her behalf. Check whether the replacement has since arrived and obtain Ione's own confirmation where needed.

companion_register.matter: Claim that Ione asked for a standing payment, diversion or deduction
companion_register.record: Ione expressly disclaims all three in b9k4. Her request for possible help for Sella in her own right is separate from the request to account for out-of-pocket expenses separately.

ordinary_finance.record: Una Cresset reports in t3w6 that £12.60 was reimbursed, that the postage slip was attached, and that she matched the reimbursement on 5 June to the office operating account. This is not a settlement distribution. The 11 June reconciliation records neither item as recharged and names Sella as payee and queries contact for EX-K4 only.

Una Cresset reports a submitted £8.40 charge. The expense list refers to a receipt, but the office did not receive it and has no copy or substitute voucher. The reconciliation explicitly contradicts any claim that this amount was paid or was an authorised balance. Obtain the receipt or an acceptable substitute and resolve it through the office expense process, separately from either distribution decision.
